idea.title: Fourteen no's
idea.summary: A nervous night-before interview rehearsal where the stranger interviewer is brutally good because he has failed fourteen interviews himself, ending on a sweet line.
hookOptions: he failed 14 interviews, then coached mine
interview at 9 tomorrow. panicking at midnight
a stranger interviewed me for practice

scenes.hook: he failed 14 interviews, then coached mine
scenes.name: Patient Biscuit
scenes.say: He failed fourteen interviews, then coached mine.

messages.text: i have an interview at 9 tomorrow and i'm panicking
ok. i'll be the interviewer. sit up straight
i'm a hard worker and a team player
boring. what did you do last saturday
i fixed my neighbour's wifi for free
that's the answer. say that tomorrow
wait, why are you so good at this
i've had 14 interviews and zero offers yet
so i know what a yes sounds like. you sound like one

post.caption: Night before an interview? Say your answers out loud to someone who isn't your mirror. What's the worst interview question you've been asked? Try it on randomtalker.com
